gloss: beet sugar; sugar from sugar beets

definitions.gloss: beet sugar; sugar refined from sugar beets
definitions.explanation: Sugar made from the sugar beet ({甜菜|てんさい}), as opposed to cane sugar. In Japan it is produced almost entirely in Hokkaido, and it is valued for a mild sweetness and for naturally containing oligosaccharides.

examples.japanese: {甜菜糖|てんさいとう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{北海道|ほっかいどう}→北海道：11010_hokkaidou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{作|つく}られている→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: Beet sugar is produced in Hokkaido.

examples.japanese: {甜菜糖|てんさいとう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{上白糖|じょうはくとう}→上白糖：25163_jouhakutou⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦{甘|あま}さ→甘さ：21344_amasa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧やさしい。
examples.english: Beet sugar has a gentler sweetness than white sugar.

examples.japanese: ⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{冷|ひ}やし→冷やす：02403_hiyasu⟧にくい⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われ→言う：00515_iu⟧、{甜菜糖|てんさいとう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{選|えら}ぶ→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: Said to be less cooling to the body, some people choose beet sugar.

notes:
Formed from {甜菜|てんさい} (sugar beet) + {糖|とう} (sugar). Contrasted with ⟦{砂糖|さとう}→砂糖：00884_satou⟧きび (sugarcane) sugar such as cane sugar and white sugar.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {甜菜糖|てんさいとう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧: to use beet sugar
- {甜菜糖|てんさいとう}⟦シロップ→シロップ：21577_shiroppu⟧: beet sugar syrup

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{黒砂糖|くろざとう}→黒砂糖：18292_kurozatou⟧: brown/dark sugar — unrefined cane sugar, stronger flavor.
- ⟦{上白糖|じょうはくとう}→上白糖：25163_jouhakutou⟧: white sugar — the common refined table sugar in Japan.
